title: Parish and Letter
author: M. M. Thornbury
blurb: Gideon Amberdale, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
